final_result_states.INCOMPLETE_rc_2: No failures but T_DEFERRED > 0 OR T_UNRESOLVED > 0 OR policy decisions outstanding. Cannot support Checkpoint 0 authorization.
final_result_states.PASS_rc_0: No failures, no mandatory gaps, all policy decisions resolved.
